checks: Default configuration leaves rates unpriced and payments disabled
Settings and order access require their own administrative permissions
Disabled checkout creates no payable session
Server authorizes test checkout only after tax, terms and key configuration
Server totals include configured first and additional shipping costs
Changing delivery method recalculates the signed quote digest
Missing POD shipping keeps mixed carts out of checkout
Forged shipping, stale totals and missing terms acceptance are rejected
Stripe receives authoritative TTC totals and only the quoted delivery country
Retrying checkout reuses the same Stripe session
An idempotency key cannot be reused with a different private access token
A public order reference alone does not disclose the order
Returning from checkout does not confirm payment
Unsigned webhook messages cannot mark a payment as paid
A completed checkout awaiting a delayed payment remains pending
A signed matching payment confirms the order
Repeated and late expiration events do not regress a paid order
Admin list exposes no receipt hash, fingerprint or checkout credentials
Private receipt status avoids exposing the customer address or email
Administrative fulfillment cannot change the financial status
A signed partial refund suspends preparation and preserves its amount
A late paid notification cannot erase a refund
A mismatched paid total places the order on hold
An unverified payment cannot be marked as shipped
A refund delivered before the checkout notification is retained
Selecting production in the UI alone cannot enable live charges
Webhooks still reconcile existing payments while new checkout is closed
Changed terms and concurrent settings saves require a fresh confirmation
